rules: Client predicts local movement for responsiveness.
Server validates movement and writes authoritative state.
Only nearby entities replicate at high frequency.
Economy, inventory, mission rewards and property ownership are server-authoritative.
NPC memories and witness reports can be synchronized as compact events rather than full NPC snapshots.
Vehicle damage and tire state are replicated as state plus event deltas.
Session IDs and player IDs are stable enough for reconnect handling.
Production deployment still requires an actual backend service.
